entities.name: Robert Joseph Shaheen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Joseph Shaheen was an American prelate of the Maronite Catholic Church. He was the former Eparch of the Eparchy of Our Lady of Lebanon. He resided at St. Raymond's Cathedral in St. Louis, Missouri.
